pages.title: Ender Arrow
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r I$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Bows, Crossbows$(br2)§lEffect: §r When an arrow hits a block or entity, teleports the shooter to the impact point; entity hits teleport one block in front of the target by default, with a 3-second cooldown.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades
